steps.title: Normal vs Abnormal
steps.content: A normal condition means the body is functioning properly. Abnormal signs may indicate danger. Always compare current condition with usual behavior.

steps.title: A person is breathing 22 times per minute but speaking clearly. What is this?
steps.hint: Think about whether they can function.
steps.correctExplanation: Breathing 22 times per minute while speaking clearly is normal.
steps.incorrectExplanation: If they can speak clearly, it is not an emergency.

steps.title: What does an abnormal sign indicate?
Match each sign to its category
steps.correctExplanation: Calm breathing is normal, mild fatigue is borderline, unable to speak is abnormal.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Order from least to most concerning.

steps.title: Red Flags
steps.content: Red flags are signs that indicate immediate danger. These include severe chest pain, difficulty breathing, unconsciousness, and heavy bleeding.

steps.title: Which of these is a red flag?
steps.correctExplanation: Severe chest pain is a red flag indicating possible cardiac emergency.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Mild headache is not immediately life-threatening.

steps.title: Arrange severity from least to most dangerous
steps.hint: Think about which threatens life most.
steps.correctExplanation: Unconsciousness is most dangerous, mild discomfort is least.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Severity increases from mild discomfort to unconsciousness.

steps.title: Name one red flag symptom
steps.aiPrompt: Identify a red flag emergency symptom
steps.hint: Think about breathing, chest, or consciousness.

steps.title: Breathing Check
steps.content: Normal breathing is steady and effortless. Abnormal breathing may be too fast, too slow, or irregular.

steps.title: A person gasping for air is:
steps.correctExplanation: Gasping for air signals a breathing emergency.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Normal breathing is effortless and steady.

steps.title: Steps to check breathing
steps.correctExplanation: Look → listen → feel is the standard breathing check sequence.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Always start by observing before listening and feeling.

steps.title: What is one abnormal breathing sign?
steps.hint: Think about gasping or no breathing.

steps.title: Responsiveness
steps.content: A responsive person reacts to voice or touch. An unresponsive person does not react at all and may be in serious danger.

steps.title: A person does not respond to voice or touch. This is:
steps.correctExplanation: No response to voice or touch means the person is unresponsive.
steps.incorrectExplanation: A responsive person reacts to stimuli.

steps.title: Steps to check consciousness
steps.correctExplanation: Call out → tap shoulder → observe response.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Always try verbal stimulus before physical.
